automated.summary: CAPRULE-1 makes scheduled runs actually use the capabilities/commands their agent is host-granted, and collapses a denied-tool pause to one plain-language notification. Falsifiers: a scheduled worker-local miss authorizes a host-granted google.sheets capability command via the host coordinator; an ungranted command still denies terminally (host consulted exactly once); the settings yolo-denylist stays terminal BEFORE the host consult (host approval cannot override it); Browser/canonical capabilities keep working; a denied-tool pause emits exactly one user notification with no duplicate terminal card and mobile-first copy; a running lifecycle message is retired best-effort with no duplicate even on unsupported backends; the plain-language setup-story copy replaces the Failed action/Triggering step/Run outcome/Blockers jargon.
